title: Ackee and Umami Omelette
description: A French-inspired omelette filled with ackee, umami, and a hint of bliss. Perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, beat the eggs with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat the butter in a medium non-stick skillet over medium heat.
3. Add the ackee and cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
4. Pour the eggs over the ackee and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are nearly set.
5. Sprinkle the umami over the eggs and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
6. Use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in half.
7. Cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, until the eggs are fully set.
8. Slide the omelette onto a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
10. Optional: add a sprinkle of bliss for an extra burst of flavor.
